description: Nomas Research lets ChatGPT look up structured SEC data: company facts, parsed filings (8-K, 10-K/Q, 13D, 144, D, 14A, S-1/S-3), insider trades, 13F holdings, and failure-to-deliver. Tools are read-only retrieval against Nomas RAG APIs. Users sign in on nomas.fyi; Free, Pro, and API plans still apply.
